rules: Short simple English for Class 6-10. Correct natural Malayalam. Answers countable from the prompt text itself. Counting, spot-the-difference, letter-compare only.

sample.prompt_en: Count the stars in this row: ★ ☆ ★ ☆ ★ How many stars total?
sample.prompt_ml: ഈ വരിയിലെ നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ എണ്ണൂ: ★ ☆ ★ ☆ ★ ആകെ എത്ര?
sample.explanation_en: There are 5 star symbols in the row.
